official_product_identity: 2024 TIGER/Line Shapefile, Census Tracts, Michigan (state FIPS 26)
source_geography_and_type: Michigan statewide Census Tracts TIGER/Line ZIP archive; public source evidence for later separately authorized Michigan GEO execution.

retrieval.method: HTTPS GET of the exact source_reference URL; do not use a Current service, TIGERweb output, another release, or a transformed derivative.

checksum_semantics: SHA-256 over the exact downloaded tl_2024_26_tract.zip bytes before extraction or interpretation.

expected_file_properties.expected_crs_reference: NAD83 geographic coordinates as supplied by the TIGER/Line projection metadata; DATA-04 does not establish a new transformation operation.

reproduction: Download exactly source_reference as bytes; require exact filename, byte length, ZIP members, member hashes, source-byte SHA-256, STATEFP 26, required DBF fields, 3,017 unique GEOID component identities, 3,017 structurally valid geometry records, and 3,017 parseable internal points.
failure_behavior: Fail closed on unavailable URL, filename/product/vintage mismatch, byte-length or checksum mismatch, incomplete archive, field/schema drift, non-Michigan row, malformed or duplicate GEOID, attribute/geometry count mismatch, invalid geometry, incompatible CRS metadata, or tract-count mismatch. Do not substitute another vintage, TIGERweb, Current service, or derivative.
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 TIGER/Line Shapefiles. Legal disclaimer and citation terms: https://www2.census.gov/geo/pdfs/maps-data/data/tiger/tgrshp2024/TGRSHP2024_TechDoc_Ch1.pdf

lineage.geo_boundary: This is complete statewide public source evidence only. DATA-04 does not create a Michigan market inventory or alter accepted GEO methodology.

supersession_policy: A correction or new accepted release requires a new manifest ID/version and explicit supersedes lineage; never overwrite this accepted manifest.
